angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 649,784 km at 132.16 pc = 0.07 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.5664 +/- 0.0121 mas (same row, RUWE 0.84): 132.16 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.934 +/- 0.011 solar radii from Galarza et al. 2024, the stellar radius of TOI-1173 b's parameter set from Galarza et al. 2024 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168...91G/abstract): 649,784 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.911 +/- 0.028 solar masses from Galarza et al. 2024, the stellar mass of TOI-1173 b's parameter set from Galarza et al. 2024 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168...91G/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5350 +/- 34 K from Galarza et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of TOI-1173 b's parameter set from Galarza et al. 2024 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168...91G/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Galarza et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of TOI-1173 b's parameter set from Galarza et al. 2024 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168...91G/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1173.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.457, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1173 (pscomppars): spectral type G9, from Galarza et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168...91G/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1173 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.191 dex, from Polanski et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJS..272...32P/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1173 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.16877, from Polanski et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJS..272...32P/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1173 (pscomppars): age 8.7 Gyr, from Galarza et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168...91G/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1173 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2 km/s, from Galarza et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168...91G/abstract)
